events.name: LEGO Stores and Pokémon GO
events.summary: The Pokémon GO and LEGO Group partnership continues for Trainers in the US, UK, Poland, France, Germany, and Australia! Visit participating LEGO Store locations for raids, a LEGO-themed stamp rally, event stickers, and LEGO Pokémon SMART Play. The LEGO Stores and Pokémon GO event will take place from August 3, 2026 at 10 am to September 30, 2026 at 11 pm.

events.name: Twilight Trails
events.summary: Welcome to Pokémon GO: Twilight Trails! In Pokémon GO, Seasons are periods of time that feature new events, Pokémon debuts, and surprises that all follow a certain theme. As the Seasons change, you may find different Pokémon appearing in your area and hatching from Eggs. Make sure to explore during each in-game Season to collect and train as many different Pokémon as you can! You’ll also enjoy special bonuses as you do.
events.summary_ms: Selamat datang ke Pokémon GO: Twilight Trails! Dalam Pokémon GO, Seasons ialah tempoh masa yang menampilkan acara baharu, kemunculan sulung Pokémon, dan kejutan yang semuanya mengikut tema tertentu. Apabila Seasons berubah, anda mungkin akan menemui Pokémon berbeza muncul di kawasan anda dan menetas dari Eggs. Pastikan anda meneroka semasa setiap Season dalam permainan untuk mengumpul dan melatih seberapa banyak Pokémon berbeza yang anda boleh! Anda juga akan menikmati bonus istimewa semasa melakukannya.
